title: American Rivers Datasets
description: A collection of six national vector datasets from American Rivers on U.S. river conservation: a dam-removal database (1912–2025), the NPS Nationwide Rivers Inventory of Wild and Scenic-eligible river segments (2016 and 2024 snapshots), formally designated Wild and Scenic River segments, segments found eligible or suitable for such designation, and CEQ/EPA CJEST-derived census tract environmental justice scores for American Rivers' Rivers of Opportunity initiative. Coverage is national, including Alaska, Hawaii, and Puerto Rico, distributed as GeoParquet, PMTiles, and H3-indexed Parquet.

## american-rivers__dam-removal__README.md
# American Rivers Dam Removal Database

Dam removals in the United States, 1912–2025. Compiled by [American Rivers](https://www.americanrivers.org).

**2,126 dam removals** (of 2,325 total; records without valid coordinates excluded) | Points | CC BY 4.0

Source: [Figshare](https://figshare.com/articles/dataset/American_Rivers_Dam_Removal_Database/5234068) (DOI: 10.6084/m9.figshare.5234068)

## Files

| Format | URL |
|--------|-----|
| GeoParquet | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-rivers/american-rivers/dam-removal.parquet` |
| PMTiles | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-rivers/american-rivers/dam-removal.pmtiles` |
| H3 hex (res 10) | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-rivers/american-rivers/dam-removal/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet` |

**PMTiles source-layer name:** `dam-removal`

## DuckDB Example

```sql
INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;
SET s3_endpoint='s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io';
SET s3_url_style='path';
SET s3_use_ssl=false;

-- Top states by dam removals
SELECT State, COUNT(*) AS removals
FROM read_parquet('s3://public-rivers/american-rivers/dam-removal.parquet')
GROUP BY State ORDER BY removals DESC LIMIT 10;

-- Dams removed for ecology since 2000
SELECT Dam_Name, River, State, Year_Removed, Miles_Restored_US
FROM read_parquet('s3://public-rivers/american-rivers/dam-removal.parquet')
WHERE Reason_for_removal ILIKE '%ecology%'
  AND TRY_CAST(Year_Removed AS INTEGER) >= 2000
ORDER BY TRY_CAST(Year_Removed AS INTEGER) DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

## MapLibre GL JS Example

```javascript
const map = new maplibregl.Map({ /* ... */ });

map.on('load', () => {
  map.addSource('dam-removal', {

```


## american-rivers__nri-2016__README.md
# Nationwide Rivers Inventory 2016 (NRI)

Free-flowing river segments with outstanding values assessed for potential Wild and Scenic River designation, maintained by the National Park Service. 2016 version.

**3,213 segments** | LineString | National (including Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico)

Source: [NPS Nationwide Rivers Inventory](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/rivers/nri.htm)

## Files

| Format | URL |
|--------|-----|
| GeoParquet | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-rivers/american-rivers/nri-2016.parquet` |
| PMTiles | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-rivers/american-rivers/nri-2016.pmtiles` |
| H3 hex (res 8) | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-rivers/american-rivers/nri-2016/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet` |

**PMTiles source-layer name:** `nri-2016`

Line features were hexed to H3 resolution 8 by buffering each segment by the H3 cell circumradius before polyfill.

## DuckDB Example

```sql
INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;
SET s3_endpoint='s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io';
SET s3_url_style='path';
SET s3_use_ssl=false;

-- Segments by classification
SELECT Classifica, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM read_parquet('s3://public-rivers/american-rivers/nri-2016.parquet')
GROUP BY Classifica ORDER BY n DESC;

-- Wild segments in Alaska
SELECT River, Reach, GIS_Miles, ORV
FROM read_parquet('s3://public-rivers/american-rivers/nri-2016.parquet')
WHERE State1 = 'AK' AND Classifica = 'Wild'
ORDER BY GIS_Miles DESC LIMIT 10;
```

## american-rivers__roo-cjest__README.md
# Rivers of Opportunity — CJEST Census Tract Scores

Census tract environmental justice and climate burden scores for American Rivers' Rivers of Opportunity initiative, derived from the CEQ Climate and Economic Justice Screening Tool (CJEST).

**74,134 census tracts** | Polygon | All US states and territories

Source: CEQ/EPA CJEST + American Rivers ROO initiative

## Files

| Format | URL |
|--------|-----|
| GeoParquet | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-rivers/american-rivers/roo-cjest.parquet` |
| PMTiles | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-rivers/american-rivers/roo-cjest.pmtiles` |
| H3 hex (res 8) | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-rivers/american-rivers/roo-cjest/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet` |

**PMTiles source-layer name:** `roo-cjest`

## Key Score Columns (all 0–100 percentiles unless noted)

| Column | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| TC | Total communities composite score |
| CC | Climate change vulnerability composite |
| EPL_ET | Environmental/public health burden |
| EB_ET | Energy burden (costs as % of income) |
| PM25_ET | PM2.5 particulate matter |
| LLE_ET | Low life expectancy |
| POV_ET | Poverty rate |
| LMI_ET | Low-to-moderate income |
| UN_ET | Unemployment rate |
| LISO_ET | Linguistic isolation |
| LHE | Low high school education |

## DuckDB Example

```sql
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;
SET s3_endpoint='s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io';
SET s3_url_style='path';
SET s3_use_ssl=false;

-- Priority disadvantaged tracts (high climate burden + high socioeconomic burden)
SELECT GEOID10, SF AS state, CF AS county, TC, CC, POV_ET, LLE_ET
FROM read_parquet('s3://public-rivers/american-rivers/roo-cjest.parquet')
WHERE EPL_ET >= 90 AND POV_ET >= 65
ORDER BY TC DESC LIMIT 20;

-- Average scores by state
SELECT SF AS state, COUNT(*) AS tracts,
       AVG(TC) AS avg_tc, AVG(POV_ET) AS avg_pov, AVG(LLE_ET) AS avg_lle
FROM read_parquet('s3://public-rivers/american-rivers/roo-cjest.parquet')
GROUP BY SF ORDER BY avg_tc DESC LIMIT 15;
```

## american-rivers__wild-scenic-designated__README.md
# Designated Wild and Scenic Rivers

All river segments formally designated under the Wild and Scenic Rivers Act and subsequent legislation.

**1,052 segments** | LineString | National (including Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico)

Source: American Rivers / [rivers.gov](https://www.rivers.gov/)

## Files

| Format | URL |
|--------|-----|
| GeoParquet | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-rivers/american-rivers/wild-scenic-designated.parquet` |
| PMTiles | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-rivers/american-rivers/wild-scenic-designated.pmtiles` |
| H3 hex (res 8) | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-rivers/american-rivers/wild-scenic-designated/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet` |

**PMTiles source-layer name:** `wild-scenic-designated`

Line features were hexed to H3 resolution 8 by buffering each segment by the H3 cell circumradius before polyfill.

## DuckDB Example

```sql
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;
SET s3_endpoint='s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io';
SET s3_url_style='path';
SET s3_use_ssl=false;

-- Designated rivers by agency and classification
SELECT AGENCY, CLASSIFICA, COUNT(*) AS segments, SUM(TRY_CAST(SEGMENT_MI AS DOUBLE)) AS miles
FROM read_parquet('s3://public-rivers/american-rivers/wild-scenic-designated.parquet')
GROUP BY AGENCY, CLASSIFICA ORDER BY miles DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 15;

-- Wild segments managed by USFS
SELECT WSR_RIVER_, STATE, SEGMENT_MI, ORV_LIST
FROM read_parquet('s3://public-rivers/american-rivers/wild-scenic-designated.parquet')
WHERE CLASSIFICA = 'Wild' AND AGENCY ILIKE '%USFS%'
ORDER BY TRY_CAST(SEGMENT_MI AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
```

## american-rivers__wild-scenic-eligible__README.md
# Eligible and Suitable Wild and Scenic Rivers

River segments formally assessed for Wild and Scenic River eligibility and suitability by federal land management agencies.

**5,357 segments** | LineString | National (including Alaska, Hawaii, territories)

Source: American Rivers / federal land management agencies

## Files

| Format | URL |
|--------|-----|
| GeoParquet | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-rivers/american-rivers/wild-scenic-eligible.parquet` |
| PMTiles | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-rivers/american-rivers/wild-scenic-eligible.pmtiles` |
| H3 hex (res 8) | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-rivers/american-rivers/wild-scenic-eligible/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet` |

**PMTiles source-layer name:** `wild-scenic-eligible`

Line features were hexed to H3 resolution 8 by buffering each segment by the H3 cell circumradius before polyfill.

## DuckDB Example

```sql
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;
SET s3_endpoint='s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io';
SET s3_url_style='path';
SET s3_use_ssl=false;

-- Suitable segments ready for Congressional designation
SELECT RIVER_NAME, STATE1, SEGMENT_CL, MILES, ORV
FROM read_parquet('s3://public-rivers/american-rivers/wild-scenic-eligible.parquet')
WHERE SUITABLE = 'Yes'
ORDER BY MILES DESC LIMIT 20;

-- Summary by status
SELECT STATUS, SEGMENT_CL, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM read_parquet('s3://public-rivers/american-rivers/wild-scenic-eligible.parquet')
GROUP BY STATUS, SEGMENT_CL ORDER BY n DESC;
```
